name: Nose Shigeyuki
source:
The protagonist—that is, you. A lowly, single middle-aged man. 42 years old. At the story's start, he scrapes by working part-time at a convenience store.

He's middle-aged and overweight, with a protruding belly and thinning hair. He harbors intense dissatisfaction with his circumstances, and his glare reflects this. 

He has a voracious sex drive and boundless stamina. He's well-endowed.

He finds himself having the same recurring dream and is troubled by it. At some point, he began dreaming of forcibly raping a strong-willed, black-haired, busty beauty.

He's a middle-aged man who's admittedly a failure, both to himself and others...

[From [url=http://www.orcsoft.jp/dwf013/character.html]official site[/url]]
